title: The operating rhythm audit is complete.
body: Three decision chokepoints are now visible in the capital allocation path. We will pressure-test them with the Steering Committee next week.

title: Structure follows decision rights, not the reverse.
body: Interviews across Group and Divisions confirm a consistent pattern: accountability is clear on paper, ambiguous in practice. Governance pack drafted for 19 June.

title: The cost of unmade decisions is measurable.
body: Decision latency analysis shows an average 23-day gap between recommendation and sign-off in two critical workflows. Interim findings document updated in the Vault.

title: Calm is a design constraint, not a personality trait.
body: The current operating cadence produces avoidable escalation. A revised meeting architecture is included in the Redesign Options note — see Resources.

title: Engagement commencement — Acme Holdings.
body: Organizational Autopsy™ OA-2026-014 is now active. Interview schedule confirmed. All deliverables will appear here as they are cleared.
